directAnswer: To update Bluetooth headphones for dual device connectivity, ensure your headphones support multipoint pairing and follow the pairing instructions for each device.
summary: This guide provides steps to update Bluetooth headphones for use with two devices simultaneously, including platform-specific instructions and common questions.

sections.heading: Pairing Headphones with Two Devices
sections.body: Most modern Bluetooth headphones support multipoint technology, allowing them to connect to two devices at once. Check your headphone model for this feature.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The pairing process may vary slightly between devices. Follow the steps below for common platforms.

steps.title: Prepare Headphones for Pairing
steps.detail: Put your Bluetooth headphones in pairing mode. This usually involves holding the power button until you see a blinking LED light.

steps.title: Connect to First Device
steps.detail: On your first device, go to Bluetooth settings and select your headphones from the list of available devices.

steps.title: Connect to Second Device
steps.detail: While still connected to the first device, repeat the pairing process with the second device. Select the headphones from the Bluetooth settings.

steps.title: Switching Between Devices
steps.detail: Once paired, you can switch audio between devices by playing audio on the desired device. The headphones should automatically connect.

faqs.question: Can all Bluetooth headphones connect to two devices?
faqs.answer: No, only headphones with multipoint technology can connect to two devices simultaneously.

faqs.question: What if my headphones don’t support multipoint?
faqs.answer: If your headphones do not support multipoint, you will need to disconnect from one device to connect to another.

faqs.question: How do I know if my headphones are in pairing mode?
faqs.answer: Most headphones indicate pairing mode with a blinking LED light. Refer to the user manual for specific indicators.

caveats: Multipoint connectivity may vary in performance based on the devices being connected.
Some features may not be available when connected to two devices.
